rules.question: Which sentence, and which details line under it, does an error show the user?
rules.owner: plain_error, plain_error_detail, plain_error_line and plain_error_block in src/app/user_messages.cpp
rules.decision: the user's rule of 2026-10-15: every failure and error line is derived once (task ERR-ONCE)
must_match: return std::string("Failed to write chart library: ") + e.what();

owner_lines.why: a store site, not a display: the stored failure keeps the error's own words, and plain_error reads them back with the stored kind (D249)

rules.note: The batch's failure list showed a chart with no notes twice: the sentence, then the same words again as the details line, because the batch read e.what() itself instead of asking plain_error_detail. Every screen and command-line tool now takes an error's words from user_messages.cpp, so a details line that repeats its sentence is fixed in one place. A line that throws a KindedError around an inner error's words is a throw site, not a display: it hands the words to the owner, which reads them back. tools/ is out of scope: those developer tools are not shipped (CMakeLists.txt's install rules). Decided by: the user, 2026-10-15.
